name: Cogs, Claws & Capes
summary: Create engineering, revived dinosaurs and hard-earned superpowers on Forge 1.20.1.
hero_namespaces_note: Mods whose crafting recipes are rewritten into Create-gated recipes live in overrides/kubejs/server_scripts/hero_gating.js (HERO_MODS).
undeclared_dependencies_note: Required at boot but missing from the Modrinth pages: kotlinforforge (flightlib, via create-jetpack), corewithstuff + gravecore (satsu-iron-man-addon). Found by the server boot test. irons_lib 1.20.1-2.x (irons-spells-n-spellbooks). dampened (FSang's power-dampening blocks/effect dampened:genetic; optional per Modrinth, but its power fails to parse without it).
server_access_note: online-mode=false so offline (non-paid) accounts can join. TrueUUID (client+server) verifies paid accounts with Mojang and blocks offline reuse of verified names; OfflineAuth (server) makes offline accounts /register + /login.
